name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 47 - Am 138
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 47 b. Stresses the importance of European exports of agricultural and wine products for the Union’s trade balance and emphasises the impact of recent retaliatory measures on European agricultural products, such as pork meat; underlines that European producers of wines, spirits and agricultural products must not become adjustment variables in trade actions related to other industrial sectors; calls on the Commission to establish targeted and effective support mechanisms for the sectors affected by such measures and to seek diplomatic avenues to mitigate the impact of such retaliatory actions;
